column2: Though presented as history, the documentary was tendentious, selecting only facts that supported its sponsor's cause.
column3: 這部紀錄片雖以歷史之名呈現，卻帶有傾向，只挑選支持贊助者立場的事實。
column4: tendentious argument (有偏頗傾向的論點)
column5: tend 傾向，總是往同一邊傾斜的說法

column2: The columnist's vitriolic attack on the mayor, full of bitter insults, shocked even her allies.
column3: 專欄作家對市長那篇充滿惡毒侮辱的尖刻攻擊，連她的盟友都感到震驚。
column5: vitriol 是硫酸，話像硫酸一樣會灼傷人

column2: The acrimonious divorce dragged on for years, with both sides trading bitter accusations in court.
column3: 那場火藥味濃厚的離婚官司拖了數年，雙方在法庭上互相指責。
column5: acr 酸辣 + mony，吵架吵到嘴裡又酸又辣

column2: Her caustic wit left the room silent, for every joke stung like acid on a cut.
column3: 她辛辣的機智讓整個房間安靜下來，每個笑話都像酸液滴在傷口上般刺人。
column5: 「烤死的」，像烤焦味一樣嗆辣刺鼻

column2: The senator's trenchant critique cut straight to the flaw in the budget that everyone else had missed.
column3: 參議員一針見血的批評直指預算中其他人都漏掉的缺陷。
column5: trench 壕溝，像鏟子一鏟就挖到底

column2: The cartoonist's mordant humor spared no politician, biting each one with sharp irony.
column3: 漫畫家尖銳的幽默沒放過任何政客，用犀利的反諷咬每個人一口。
column5: mor 像 more bite，多咬一口，話帶刺

column2: The journalist's polemical essay attacked her opponents so forcefully that it read like a battle cry.
column3: 這位記者好爭論的文章猛烈攻擊對手，讀起來像一聲戰吼。
column5: poly 很多 + mic 麥克風，大聲爭辯

column2: Contentious issues such as land rights often turn town meetings into hours of heated argument.
column3: 土地權之類具爭議的議題常使鎮民大會變成數小時的激烈爭論。
column5: content 內容 + ious，每個內容都要爭一下

column2: The belligerent neighbor threatened to sue everyone on the street over a few fallen leaves.
column3: 那位好鬥的鄰居為了幾片落葉就威脅要告街上每個人。
column5: bell 鈴聲響起就開戰，像拳擊鈴好鬥

column2: The truculent guard glared at every visitor and snapped at anyone who asked a question.
column3: 那位兇悍的警衛瞪著每位訪客，對任何發問的人都厲聲呵斥。
column5: truck 卡車橫衝直撞，愛挑釁的架式

column2: Her pacific nature made her the one friend who could calm any quarrel in the group.
column3: 她愛好和平的天性使她成為朋友中唯一能平息任何爭吵的人。
column5: pacific 與太平洋同字，太平洋就是「平靜之海」

column2: In the debate over the border dispute, the dovish minister urged talks instead of troop movements.
column3: 在邊界爭端的辯論中，鴿派的部長主張談判而非調動軍隊。
column5: dove 是和平鴿，鴿子叼橄欖枝求和

column2: The irenic tone of the letter helped heal the rift between the two churches.
column3: 那封信的調和語氣幫助修補了兩個教會之間的裂痕。
column5: Irene 是希臘和平女神的名字，念起來像「愛人」

column2: The prodigal heir squandered his inheritance on parties and horses within two years.
column3: 那位揮霍的繼承人在兩年內把遺產花在派對和馬匹上。
column5: pro 往前 + dig 挖，挖光家產往外丟

column2: Critics blamed the profligate spending of the previous government for the empty treasury.
column3: 批評者將國庫空虛歸咎於前任政府的揮霍無度。
column5: pro 往前 + flig 打，錢被一路打散花光

column2: A notorious spendthrift, he bought three cars in a month and then borrowed money for rent.
column3: 他是個出了名的揮霍者，一個月買了三輛車，然後借錢付房租。
column4: a spendthrift heir (揮霍無度的繼承人)
column5: spend 花 + thrift 節儉，把節儉全花光

column2: Growing up poor taught her to be frugal, saving leftovers and repairing clothes instead of replacing them.
column3: 貧窮的成長環境教她節儉，會留剩菜並修補衣服而不是換新的。
column5: 「福果」，存起來的水果就是福氣，勤儉有福

column2: The parsimonious landlord refused to repair the heater, though the winter was bitterly cold.
column3: 那位吝嗇的房東雖然冬天極冷，卻不肯修理暖氣。
column5: par 像 pair 一雙，連一雙襪子都捨不得買

column2: After the factory closed, the penurious family counted every coin to buy bread for the week.
column3: 工廠關閉後，貧困的一家人數著每一枚硬幣來買一週的麵包。
column5: pen 筆 + ur，連買一支筆都沒錢

column2: The miserly shopkeeper reused tea bags for weeks and never gave a penny to charity.
column3: 那位小氣的店主把茶包重複用好幾個星期，從不捐一分錢給慈善機構。
column5: miser 守財奴 + ly，抱著錢袋不放

column2: A munificent donor funded the new library, the science wing, and scholarships for every graduate.
column3: 一位慷慨的捐贈者出資興建新圖書館、科學館，並為每位畢業生提供獎學金。
column5: muni 禮物 + fic 做，常常做禮物送人

column2: Though wronged by his rival, the magnanimous champion shook his hand and praised his skill.
column3: 雖然被對手欺負，寬宏大量的冠軍仍與他握手並稱讚他的技巧。
column5: magna 大 + anim 心靈，心胸大的人

column2: The merchant's avarice grew with every coin he hoarded, until nothing could ever satisfy him.
column3: 那位商人的貪婪隨著囤積的每一枚硬幣增長，直到什麼都無法滿足他。
column5: a 啊 + varice，看到錢眼睛發亮就停不下來

column2: Rapacious landlords seized the villagers' fields and left them with nothing to plant.
column3: 貪婪掠奪的地主奪走村民的田地，讓他們沒有東西可種。
column5: rap 搶奪，像 rape 字根表搶，一把抓走

column2: Cupidity drove the clerk to falsify the accounts, hoping to pocket a little more each month.
column3: 貪慾驅使職員竄改帳目，希望每個月多放一點進自己口袋。
column5: Cupid 邱比特，貪心追著愛與錢跑

column2: A voracious reader, she finished three novels each weekend and still asked for more.
column3: 她是個求知若渴的讀者，每個週末讀完三本小說還想要更多。
column5: vor 吞 + acious，像吞書一樣狼吞虎嚥

column2: His insatiable curiosity led him to dismantle every clock in the house just to see how it worked.
column3: 他無窮的好奇心使他拆開家裡每個時鐘，只為了看它如何運作。
column5: in 不 + sati 飽足，怎麼吃都不飽

column2: A plethora of street food stalls lined the market, offering dishes from every region of the country.
column3: 市場兩側排滿大量的街頭小吃攤，提供來自全國各地的菜餚。
column4: a plethora of options (過多的選擇)
column5: pleth 像 plenty，多到滿出來

column2: After the third helping of cake, the guests felt a surfeit of sweetness and pushed their plates away.
column3: 吃完第三份蛋糕後，賓客覺得甜得過量，便把盤子推開。
column4: a surfeit of sweets (甜食過量)
column5: sur 超過 + feit 做，做太多吃太膩

column2: Editors cut the superfluity from the manuscript, removing every paragraph that repeated an earlier point.
column3: 編輯刪除稿件中的多餘部分，拿掉每一段重複先前論點的文字。
column4: cut the superfluity (刪去多餘之物)
column5: super 超過 + flu 流，滿到溢出來流掉

column2: A glut of cheap oil sent prices tumbling and forced several producers to close their wells.
column3: 大量廉價石油供過於求，使價格暴跌，迫使數家生產商關閉油井。
column4: a glut of goods (貨物供過於求)
column5: glue 黏滿滿，貨物塞滿倉庫動不了

column2: A dearth of rain in spring left the fields dry and the farmers anxious about the harvest.
column3: 春天雨水匱乏讓農田乾涸，農民為收成焦慮。
column4: a dearth of rain (雨水匱乏)
column5: dear 昂貴，缺貨東西就變貴

column2: The paucity of surviving documents makes it hard for historians to reconstruct daily life in the village.
column3: 倖存文獻的稀少使歷史學家很難重現村莊的日常生活。
column5: pau 像 pour，只倒出一小滴，少得可憐

column2: Water scarcity forced the town to ration supplies during the long dry summer.
column3: 缺水迫使小鎮在漫長乾燥的夏天實施配給供水。
column5: scar 疤，缺東西像缺了一塊留下疤

column2: Her meager wages barely covered rent, leaving almost nothing for food or clothing.
column3: 她微薄的薪水勉強夠付房租，幾乎沒剩下錢買食物或衣服。
column5: 「米個」只有一粒米，少得可憐

column2: Only comments germane to the proposal were allowed, so unrelated complaints were saved for later.
column3: 只有與提案密切相關的意見才被允許，不相干的抱怨留待稍後。
column4: germane to the issue (與議題密切相關)
column5: germ 種子，同一顆種子長出來的就是相關

column2: The lawyer asked only pertinent questions, each one aimed at the exact moment of the accident.
column3: 律師只問切題的問題，每一題都針對事故發生的確切時刻。
column5: per 穿過 + tin 握住，直接抓到重點

column2: His joke seemed apropos, arriving just as the tense meeting needed a moment of laughter.
column3: 他的笑話正逢其時，在緊張的會議最需要笑聲的時刻出現。
column5: 法文 a propos，「阿普拉博」剛好合適

column2: The poet found an apposite quotation from Shakespeare to match the mood of the funeral.
column3: 詩人找到一句莎士比亞的貼切引文來配合那場葬禮的氣氛。
column5: ap 靠近 + pos 放，剛好放對位置

column2: Remove any extraneous details from your summary so the main point stands out clearly.
column3: 把摘要中任何不相干的細節刪掉，讓主要論點清楚突顯。
column5: extra 額外 + neous，多出來不屬於這裡
